references.text: Introduces the topic of flying swarming creatures with four feet that are an abomination, and provides context for verse 23.
Describes the exceptions among flying swarming creatures that are permitted to eat, in contrast to the prohibition in verse 23.
Repeats the prohibition against eating swarming creatures and extends it to all swarming creatures that crawl on the ground.
A parallel law in Deuteronomy declaring that all flying swarming creatures are unclean.
Uses the same term 'שֶׁקֶץ' (abomination) for unclean birds, showing consistency in the purity laws.
Mentions 'שֶׁרֶץ' (swarming creature) as unclean in the context of sacrificial law.
